questions.question: In a circle, AB is the diameter and CD is a chord. AB and CD produced meet at a point P, outside the circle. If PD = 15.3 cm, CD = 11.9 cm and AP = 30.6 cm, then the radius of the circle is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/32fa7b2bc046ff33433698cad8a19701b52deb5edce162aba79867924f7fd5ca.png] 

PC = PD + CD = 15.3 + 11.9 = 27.2

AP × PB = PD × PC

⇒ 30.6 × PB = 15.3 × 27.2

⇒ PB = (15.3 × 27.2)/30.6

⇒ PB = 13.6 

Now, AB = AP - PB = 30.6 - 13.6 = 17 cm

Radius of the circle = 17/2 = 8.5 cm

questions.question: From an external point P, a tangent PQ is drawn to a circle, with the centre O, touching the circle at Q. if the distance of P from the centre is 13 cm and length of the tangent PQ is 12 cm, then the radius of the circle is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/86d09f25c8a01c9b21585684074e7294611974d1b5b7c805b1270cdc2c9cf530.png] 

As we know,

∠OQP = 90° [tangent]

OP² = PQ² + OQ²

⇒ 13² = 12² + OQ²

⇒ OQ² = 169 - 144

⇒ OQ = √25

⇒ OQ = 5 cm

questions.question: A cell phone was marked at 20% above the cost price and discount of 10% was given on its marked price. What is the profit percentage?
questions.solution:
Let CP of cell phone was be Rs. 100

MP of the cell phone = 100 × 120/100 = 120

SP of the cell phone = 120 × 90/100 = 108

∴ Profit = 108 - 100 = 8

Profit % = 8/100 × 100 = 8%

**Short Trick : **

Profit % = 20 - 10 - (20 × 10)/100 = 10 - 2 = 8%

questions.question: If p + q = 7, pq = 5, then the value of p³ + q³ is:
questions.solution:
p + q = 7 and pq = 5

As we know,

(p + q)³ = p³ + q³ + 3pq (p + q)

⇒ 7³ = p³ + q³ + 3 × 5 × 7

⇒ p³ + q³ = 343 - 105

⇒ p³ + q³ = 238

⇒ 72° + 72° + ∠BAC = 180°

questions.question: The greatest number which may replace * in the number 1190*6 make the number divisible by 9 is
questions.solution:
Divisibility law of 9 ⇒ A number is divisible by 9 if sum of its digit is divisible by 9.

The number 1190*6 is divisible by 9 if

1 + 1 + 9 + 0 + * + 6

⇒ 17 + *

If put * = 1, then number become 18 which is divisible by 9.

questions.question: A car dealer purchased an old car Rs. 1,08,500 and spent some amount on its maintenance. He sold it for Rs. 1,56, 250, thereby earning a profit of 25%. How much money did he spend on the maintenance of the car?
questions.solution:
CP of the car = 1,08,500

Let the amount spent on car maintenance be Rs. x, then

SP of the car = 1,56,250

Price of the car after maintenance = 1,56250 × 100/125

Price of the car after maintenance = 1,25,000

x = 1,25,000 - 1,08,500

⇒ x = 16,500

questions.question: The compound interest on a certain sum at the end of two years is Rs. 408. The simple interest on the same sum for the same time is Rs. 400. The rate of interest per annum is:
questions.solution:
SI for 2 years = 400

SI for 1 year = 400/2 = 200

Difference between CI and SI = 408 - 400 = 8

∴ Rate of interest = (8/200) × 100 = 4%

questions.question: The perimeter of a square plot is the same as that of a rectangular plot with sides 35 m and 15 m. The side of the square plot is:
questions.solution:
As we know

Perimter of the square = 4a

Perimeter of the rectangle = 2 (l + b)

Sides of rectangular plot are 35 m and 15 m

Perimeter of the rectangular plot = 2 (35 + 15) = 2 × 50 = 100 m

Perimeter of square plot = perimeter of rectangular plot = 100 m

4a = 100

⇒ a = 100/4

⇒ a = 25 m

questions.question: In a class, the average score of thirty students in a test is 69. Later on, it was found that the score of one student was wrongly marked as 88 instead of 58. The actual average score is:
questions.solution:
Average score of 30 students = 69

Sum of score of 30 students = 69 × 30 = 2070

Correct sum of score of 30 students = 2070 - 88 + 58 = 2040

∴ Correct average score of 30 students = 2040/30 = 68

**__Short trick__:**

Correct average score of 30 students = 69 - (88 - 58)/30 = 69 - 30/30 = 69 - 1 = 68

questions.question: The price of cooking oil increased by 25%. Find by how much percentage a family must reduce its consumption in order to maintain the same budget.
questions.solution:
Let price of the cooking oil be Rs. 4

Price of the cooking oil after increment = 4 × (5/4) = Rs. 5

Ratio of oil price before and after = 4 : 5

Ratio of consumption before and after = 5 : 4

Required percentage = (5 - 4)/5 × 100 = 20%

questions.question: The distance between two stations, A and B, is 575 km, A train starts from station ‘A’ at 3.00 p.m and moves towards station ‘B’ at an average speed of 50 km/h. Another train starts from station ‘B’ at 3.30 p.m and moves towards station ‘A’ at an average speed of 60 km/h, how far from station ‘A’ will the trains meet?
questions.solution:
The distance between two stations, A and B = 575 km,

Speed of first train = 50 km/hr

Speed of second train = 60 km/hr

Distance covered by first train in 30 min (1/2 hr) = 50 × 1/2 = 25 km

Remaining distance = 575 - 25 = 550 km

Relative speed, if opposite direction = 50 + 60 = 110 km/hr

As we know,

Time = Distance/speed

Both train meet each other in = 550/110 = 5 hrs

Distance covered in 5 hrs by first train = 5 × 50 = 250 km

Total distance covered by first train = 25 + 250 = 275 km

Both trains meet each other 275 km far from station A.
